description_en: Invoke this API to obtain the download URLs of sound code audio files
description_zh: 调用该接口获取声码音频下载地址
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-sound-code-audio --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --sound-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSoundCodeAudio

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
